protocol.training_label: nominal50% TP1/runner signed price return; private banking verified separately with contract rounding
protocol.training_weight: one total weight per contemporaneous timestamp across both directions/all assets
protocol.entry: every quality-qualified closed session bar, both directions, no fixed regime family prerequisite
protocol.entry_quality: native current trade,75% active session bars, positive first two opening bars, close within10bp ofmark
protocol.clock: frozen2026 cash calendar; open+30min to min(open+5h,close-30min), requires prior3 closed session VWAP
protocol.stop: last3 completed mark-bar extreme +0.15 regular active ATR; floor0.3%, max1%
protocol.price_grid: frozen exact instrument tick, production rounding
protocol.cash_gate: last20 completed nominal50% paper exits positive in both price andR
protocol.threshold_qualification: >=15positive-aggregate paper signals each half; positive stock cash and>=20stock closes inSeptember across both TP1 modes/priorities
protocol.threshold_score: worst stock contribution minus shared realized cash drawdown
protocol.client_cash: 130 shared,3% each entry margin,10x,actual lots,crypto4/stocks8/shared12,90% reserved margin,two writers,15m release
protocol.crypto_reference: fixed activity-qualified frozen native crypto, checkedBE-atTP1; fresh publication gate per validation start
protocol.unknown: never flat or removed from candidate ranking; admitted unknown makes scenario unscorable
protocol.later: score only after fixed threshold selection, no refit, freshOctober PAPER20 and one continuousOct/Nov account

training.target: nominal50% first-target/runner price return, not win flag

limitations: Previously inspected history/current snapshot selection; chronology is enforced, no untouched holdout claimed.
Training excludes unknown labels and may have censoring bias; ranking/admission never silently excludes unknown candidates.
Nominal50% price label is not private fill PnL; client5% and minimum50% use actual lot rounding in separate cash replay.
Known-close plus5bp stresses/mark features are proxies, not historical executable quotes, publication latency or actual fills.
No full floating-equity guard,funding/fees,liquidation or live-account recovery reconstructed.
Fresh September selection andOctober validation accounts, continuous within each stage; November partial.
Both bots share cash/caps but current stock production remains PAPER and crypto reference is research only.
No candidate can prove30% each bot each calendar month or justify live trading from this study alone.
